name: Angelos K. Marnerides
bio: Prof. Angelos K. Marnerides is the Director of the Cyber-Physical Systems Security Lab and a faculty member at the Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering, KIOS Centre of Excellence, University of Cyprus. His research spans cyber-physical systems security, smart grid protection, network security, anomaly detection, and critical infrastructure resilience. He has published extensively on industrial control system forensics, energy theft detection, malware analysis, and intrusion detection systems.
shortBio: Lab Director and Professor specializing in CPS security and critical infrastructure protection.
